question: Which seed sounds with blazing dots hold the withdrawal of breaths?
premises: Seed sounds are adorned with blazing dots
Jha sound governs withdrawal of breaths
Sixth vowel and dot complete the formula
inference: The breath-withdrawing mantra is built from seed sounds, jha, sixth vowel and dot.
uncertainties: kṣayarava may be one compound or two words
labīja may be a damaged form of bīja
plain_english: With seeds of destruction and sound, blazing and adorned with dots, the life-breaths are withdrawn by the jha sound, together with the sixth vowel and dot.
